summary: Two-story 10x10 cab dated to 1934 in the Frank Church Wilderness, used into the 1970s, abandoned after, and registered in 2016.

facts.status_note: Abandoned since the 1970s. The register's photo is dated August 2015, and no source describes its condition since then.

staffing.status: abandoned; no documented staffing after the mid-1970s

access.note: Abandoned cab in the Frank Church-River of No Return Wilderness, reached on foot or by horseback. The 1982 history quoted by the climbing guide describes it as unsafe inside. No source describes public entry.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in only. The 1982 history quoted by the climbing guide describes at least two days along the Middle Fork-Stoddard Creek Trail from the mouth of the Middle Fork into the Main Salmon River.

corrections.why: None of the sources gives a height for this cab. They describe it only as a two-story 10x10 cab, so the 3.0 value has no source.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1934. A 1982 history quoted by the climbing guide places the build around 1945 under a forest supervisor who ordered 10x10 cabs to save money. The record uses 1934, the date three sources share, and notes the 1945 claim. The pages cannot settle it.

The register lists a 2015 photo and a 2016 registration. Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe the lookout as abandoned. No source gives its condition after 2015, so the standing status is unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 3.0 has no source; removed. Brief status standing is changed to abandoned, the status all three sources give; no source describes its condition after the 2015 photo, so standing is not asserted. Build year conflict (1934 vs about 1945) is unresolved. The climbing guide quotes a 1982 Bing Young history; the primary text was not read. Idaho Fire Lookouts lists no staff. A rental or current-condition check would need a fresher source.
